create.name: Shifu Lindsey Wei
create.bio:
Shifu Lindsey Wei (Daoist name Wei Cheng Ling) is an American teacher of Wudang internal martial arts and a 24th-generation lay disciple of the Chun Yang sect of Wudang Daoism. She spent more than nine years training under Master Li Xing De at the Five Immortals Temple on White Horse Mountain in China, studying Qigong, Tai Ji Quan, Ba Gua, the double-edged straight sword and Daoist meditation and scripture, before returning to the United States in 2010 to teach. Her memoir, The Valley Spirit: A Female Story of Daoist Cultivation, tells the story of those years.

Through her school, Wudang White Horse, she teaches the temple's curriculum as one path of cultivation: stillness meditation, Yang Sheng Gong, Tai Ji, Ba Gua circle walking, kung fu basics and the Seven Star Sword. Students learn through a monthly online membership with recorded courses and live weekly classes, and through residential immersion camps held outdoors in the Siskiyou mountains of southern Oregon, where training follows the rhythms of nature. The school's stated aim is to teach students how to teach themselves, so the practices become part of daily life. She also teaches self-paced Wudang Qigong and Daoist meditation courses on The Shift Network.

courses.title: Wudang White Horse Student Membership
courses.description: Monthly membership that opens all of the school's online courses, the live weekly review classes on Zoom and a video library of workshops and lectures. It is the main way to follow the Wudang Chun Yang curriculum from home.

courses.title: Daoist Meditation
courses.description: A 64-session archive of a weekly live cohort, each with a short teaching and 45 minutes of meditation. Methods include fasting of the mind, inner observation, the microcosmic orbit, reverse breathing and the Sleeping Dragon method, with readings from the Dao De Jing and other Daoist scriptures.
courses.price: Included in Student Membership ($49 USD per month)

courses.title: Tai Ji Quan Fundamentals
courses.description: Eight hour-long recorded classes with short Q&A sessions, designed as a training companion for Tai Ji at any level. Each class works one principle, such as rooted stepping, the three harmonies, or emptiness and fullness, through warm-ups, drills and short phrases.
courses.price: Included in Student Membership ($49 USD per month)

courses.title: Ba Gua Fundamentals
courses.description: Twelve hours of video on Wudang Wulong Tian Gang Ba Gua Zhang, the circle walking and mud stepping over sacred patterns taught at the Five Immortals Temple. It brings in the Daoist numerology, Five Elements and Ba Gua theory behind the form, with notes on Yi Jing and sacred geometry.
courses.price: Included in Student Membership ($49 USD per month)

courses.title: Seven Star Sword
courses.description: Seven recorded 90-minute classes teaching the 49 postures of the Wudang Chun Yang double-edged straight sword form. The course covers sword basics, Ba Gua stepping and the ceremonial side of the form, with a guide to choosing a sword.
courses.price: Included in Student Membership ($49 USD per month)

courses.title: Ba Gua Camp 2027
courses.description: A week-long residential immersion at Pacifica Garden in the Siskiyous of southern Oregon, taught by Lindsey Wei. Students learn the Eight Step Heavenly Big Dipper Palm of the Wudang Chun Yang sect, an old style of circle walking tied to the Eight Trigrams; meals are cooked by student teams.
courses.price: $1450 USD (tuition and food programme; lodging extra)

Book: The Valley Spirit: A Female Story of Daoist Cultivation (Singing Dragon, 2013 second edition, ISBN 9781848191310 / ISBN-10 1848191316) could not be confirmed because Amazon /dp/ pages kept returning server errors; added back if a human confirms the listing.
Most of her own-channel videos are short form demonstrations (2-4 minutes) rather than spoken teaching; some may have only music behind the movement.
All three Shift Network courses were dropped under the health-claim rule.

Kung Fu Series (8 weeks from 28 Oct 2026) and Mystery Gate scripture cohort (from 1 Oct 2026) — already started.
Weekly live classes — mostly led by senior students, and included in the membership.
